text:
anya: Heads-up — onboarding cohort for new on-call folks starts next Monday. I'm compiling shadow shifts and handoff pairs. Need to confirm primary/secondary for weekday nights and weekend coverage. Also want to run a quick tabletop with a simulated page so new joiners see the workflow. Anyone not available next Sat (11am–7pm PST)?

jon: I can cover weekday nights Mon–Thu 6pm–2am for the first two weeks. Would prefer to pair with someone who knows the routing policies.

maria: I’m the new hire joining shadowing — available most weekdays but need to be shadowed for my first three nights. happy to take secondary.

kevin: I’m OOO next Wed. I can take the Sat slot if needed but would like a backup for escalation.

lina: I can be secondary for the Sat shift. Also I can lead the tabletop simulation — I have a mock incident script.

anya: Perfect. Lina — can you paste the script and the runbook links so I can add to the onboarding checklist?

lina: Sure — short script below. Will also attach the runbook link.

lina: "SCENARIO: Increased 5xxs for /v1/generate in us-west-2. Traffic spike causes queueing and a partial model fallback to smaller quantized variant. Customer impact: high latency and some 502s for streaming."

lina: Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.internal/oncall/runbooks/service-v1-generate (note: internal)

lina: Quick play steps: 
1) Check /metrics/dashboard - token latency, qps, 5xx rate. 
2) Check routing logs: `kubectl logs svc-router -n inference | grep fallback` 
3) If fallback triggered, roll back to previous routing policy: `curl -X POST https://controlplane/api/v1/policy/route -d '{"policy":"route_to_primary"}'` (ops perms only). 
4) Notify customers via status page if >10% requests error.

anya: Good. @eng-oncall-bot can you schedule the shadow shifts and tag the primary/secondary roster?

eng-oncall-bot: Scheduled shadowing week for cohort-May. Added roster to /docs/oncall/cohort-may. Reminder DM will go out 24h before each shadow.

maria: Quick Q — if we get a page during shadow, do I respond or just listen and escalate to primary?

jon: For the first two shadows, just observe and call out notes. If page says "runbook:take-action" the primary will ask you to execute a safe checklist step (e.g., restart worker). Only execute if explicitly asked.

kevin: Can we add an explicit "no-incident-creation" rule for shadows unless the primary authorizes? Last time a new shadow accidentally created duplicate incidents.

lina: Good point — adding to the onboarding checklist: "shadows must not create new incidents or change routing unless granted temporary ops-perms by primary."

anya: Also want to use a canned page from incident-bot to run through acceptance criteria. Lina, can you signal incident-bot when we're ready?

lina: Yep — propose Thursday 09:30 PST for a 30-min tabletop + live page. Who can make it?

jon: I can. maria: can you?

maria: Yes Thursday 09:30 works.

kevin: I can join for the first 15 min.

lina: Cool — I'll trigger a low-severity page that simulates the 5xx spike. It'll include a status-check checklist. Format below: 
```
incident-bot: page severity=low service=v1-generate summary="simulated 5xx spike" links=[dashboard,runbook] tag=oncall-training
```

incident-bot: TEST PAGE: severity=low service=v1-generate summary="Simulated training page: increased 5xx" links=[https://dashboards/redwood/v1-generate, https://wiki.redwood.internal/oncall/runbooks/service-v1-generate] tag=oncall-training

maria: Nice — will be good to see the page flow (pagerduty + slack + oncall-console).

anya: Action items: 
- Lina: run tabletop + trigger incident-bot Thu 09:30 PST (assigned) 
- Jon: be primary Mon–Thu nights for week1 (confirmed) 
- Lina: secondary for Sat 11–7 (confirmed) 
- Kevin: backup escalation for Sat (confirmed) 
- Maria: shadow nights Tue/Thu week1 (confirmed) 
- Eng-oncall-bot: publish roster + send reminders (assigned)

jon: One more: add the quick grep commands and a snippet to the runbook for newbs — e.g., `journalctl -u inference-worker | tail -n 200` and `redis-cli info replication` — saves time.

lina: Added to onboarding doc. Also adding a "what to say to customers" blurb for status updates (short, non-technical).

anya: Great. If no objections I'll pin the roster and send calendar invites by EOD. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

kevin: :thumbsup:
